raw_output.title: Interview with Elena
raw_output.summary: Elena discussed the importance of accuracy in decision-making and how small errors can add up over time. She also shared her experience with the public reaction to her work.

qa_highlights.question: Why does this work matter to you?
qa_highlights.answer: Because small uh errors add up over years. A tiny drift becomes a wrong decision.

quotes.speaker: Elena
quotes.text: A few critics said the method was too slow, and they were partly right
